cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Good morning. I'm doing a survey of shoppers in Broadbeach. Would you have a few minutes to spare to answer some questions?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh...erm...yes, I guess that would be ok.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Thank you very much. Everybody seems so busy today.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well actually I don't have loads of time, so...

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Oh yes, of course. It really won't take long. Could I start by taking your name please?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Martyn Leigh. Martyn's with a Y. (Q1)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And is your family name spelt L-double-E?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: It's L-E-I-G-H.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Thank you. We don't actually publish your name or details. It just makes it easier for me to identify people when I look at all the results at the end.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I see.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And can I ask, how did you get into town today?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, normally I catch the bus, but I'm on my motorbike today because I'm going to work later. (Q2)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And could you tell me what you're doing this morning, I mean, the reason for your trip into town?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I've just been to the hairdresser. You see, I have a job interview at the council in a few days. (Q3)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Oh really! Well, good luck with that.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Thanks a lot. And now I'm on my way to buy a suit that I can wear to the interview. I don't actually own one at the moment! (Q4)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: OK. Is that everything you're planning to do in town?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yeah. Well, I've got to go and pick up my laptop. It broke a couple of days ago so I took it to the shop to get it fixed. They had to order a spare part, but apparently it's ready for collection now. I can't wait to get it back. (Q5)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: I'm sure. I hate it when my technology breaks down. ...One more thing, it's Saturday today – is that when you like to do your shopping?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well it's more a question of when I'm free. If I'm free on a Monday, that's when I choose to come into town. The shops are less busy then, which I always prefer. (Q6)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: So, I'd like to ask you a few more questions to get your views about shopping in Broadbeach, if that's ok.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sure. What would you like to know specifically?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: What would you say you like best about the shops here?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: I'd probably say it's the service you get wherever you go.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: OK. And what do you think about the range of shops in Broadbeach?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh you can get almost anything you want here.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And what about recent changes? What do you like and dislike about them? For example, there are a lot of new coffee shops now, are you enjoying them? (Q7)

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: No, there are too many of them. It's a shame as those places could be occupied by other kinds of shops.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: What would you like to see instead?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, I think we have enough clothing shops. But there's only one place that sells books at the moment. It'd be nice to have a choice, you know. (Q8)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Right. And have you been to the new shopping centre outside Broadbeach yet, Martyn?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes, once or twice. It's not that far from where I live.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: It's a very modern-looking building, isn't it?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Yes, and it's lovely. The glass roof is certainly impressive. But my favourite thing is the plants they've put around the building. They're amazing, and so big already. (Q9)

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And what about the entertainment facilities? Have you used any of them yet? Like the new cinema? (Q10)

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Nah, not yet. I can't see any advantage in having it there because the one in town is actually bigger.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: OK, well thank you so much for...
